headline: The only function that asks the live provider whether a ticker exists is BrokerSecurityCheck._lookup (resolution_broker.py:91), which issues ONE GET /securities/securities_info?securities=<sym,sym,...> (resolution_broker.py:102). It runs in the RESIDENT process on the runner host (EC2 i-0167fd745ad906a66, role irpt-ycharts-runner-role), NOT in a Lambda: no lambda-source-map entry packages resolution_broker.py or resident_session.py. The Lambda irpt-ycharts-generate runs only the POST half, which sends no vendor call and queues one resolve_upload message. The labels Total, Totals, Subtotal, Sum (and All) reach the provider as the one-word symbols TOTAL, TOTALS, SUBTOTAL, SUM, ALL; every label with a space (Grand Total, Portfolio Total, Total Portfolio, Net Total, Equity Subtotal, Fixed Income Subtotal) never reaches it. The only way found to get a live answer without a new grant is to make ONE upload through a direct invoke of irpt-ycharts-generate, as TO-APPLY-Y75 read 4 did; that is NOT a read: it writes an upload record set, a stored original, a queue message and a lease update.

provider.file_function: infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/intake/resolution_broker.py BrokerSecurityCheck._lookup (:91-134), reached through BrokerSecurityCheck.__call__ (:78) and UploadTemplateResolver.__call__ (:144)
provider.what_it_calls: The vendor (YCharts) route GET /securities/securities_info?securities=<comma list of up to 200 upper-cased symbols>: ROUTE = '/securities/securities_info' (resolution_broker.py:15); the request is transport.request(ROUTE + '?' + urlencode({'securities': ','.join(symbols)})) at resolution_broker.py:102, on a SESSIONLESS fenced transport (resident_session.py:120-131 acquire_sessionless: no secret read, no cookie, a fixed browser user agent LOOKUP_USER_AGENT at resident_session.py:18; its docstring says the lookup answers a caller with no cookie, 'measured 2026-10-01, 200 JSON'). The provider provider-lease row on irpt-jobs (tenant _opal, job ycharts-session) is taken for the call (resident_session.py:100-101 OperationLease; iam.tf YChartsSessionLease). The answer is classified by security_resolution.classify_batch (security_resolution.py:64): a symbol with no row in the answer is NOT_FOUND (reason EXACT_IDENTIFIER_ABSENT_IN_PROVIDER_READ, :140-141), one row FOUND, several AMBIGUOUS, a row with features_needed PROVIDER_ENTITLEMENT_UNVERIFIED, a refused or partial read UNAVAILABLE (:78-79).
call_chain: uploads.py:476-478 _freeze_template builds the symbol list: each template row whose symbol fullmatches SYMBOL (security_resolution.py:17) and whose A cell is not a formula, de-duplicated
uploads.py:480 self.resolve_template(principal, owner, symbols), only when 0 < len(symbols) <= 200
resolution_broker.py:144-146 UploadTemplateResolver.__call__ -> SecurityResolver.check (security_resolution.py:178), which calls provider_check(pending) at :218

wired by resident_session.py:139-146 template_resolver, composed at ycharts/generate/resident_worker.py:619 and handed to resident_upload_service (upload_resolution.py:122-134) whose service.resolve_deferred (uploads.py:423) runs _freeze_template (:443)
provider.refusals_that_are_not_answers: A failed read (lease busy, WAF, login page, status not 200, body not the expected list) is UNAVAILABLE, never NOT_FOUND (security_resolution.py:5-6, :78-79); with transient_refuses the RESOLVING row stays and the message retries (uploads.py:482-487), so a failed read gives NO answer about a label.

where_it_runs.answer: The RESIDENT supervised process on the runner host EC2 i-0167fd745ad906a66 (resident.tf header: 'ONE supervised process on i-0167fd745ad906a66'), under the instance role irpt-ycharts-runner-role (iam.tf: aws_iam_role.runner). It long-polls the irpt-generation queue and acts on the closed message kind resolve_upload (upload_resolution.py:20; resident_worker.py:619 area, execute() routes the kind).
where_it_runs.lambda_source_map_entry: infra/aws/lambda/ci/lambda-source-map.json functions.irpt-ycharts-generate (source_dir infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/ycharts/generate, iam_role irpt-ycharts-generate-role, tf infra/aws/terraform/investor-reporting/ycharts/generate.tf, 104 files). It is the ONLY entry that lists any of these files: it packages uploads.py (files[92]), upload_resolution.py (files[93]), upload_entry.py (files[91]), template_reader.py (files[95]), security_resolution.py (files[96]), portfolio.py (files[28]), resident_worker.py (files[74]). It does NOT list resolution_broker.py, resident_session.py or operation_lease.py (membership test run: False for all three). No other entry in the map lists any of the 9 files searched (resolution_broker.py, resident_session.py, uploads.py, upload_resolution.py, security_resolution.py, template_reader.py, portfolio.py, upload_entry.py, resident_worker.py): 1 of the map's functions holds any.
where_it_runs.what_the_lambda_does: irpt-ycharts-generate (served handler reports/generate_installed.py:500) is the POST door: deferred_upload_service (upload_resolution.py:102-113) is built with resolve_security and resolve_prices as _not_composed refusals and NO resolve_template; _defer (uploads.py:370-384) runs the pure read_template, publishes NORMALIZATION# in RESOLVING and sends one resolve_upload message (the generate role holds sqs:SendMessage on irpt-generation, generate.tf:136-140). It never contacts the vendor.

sequence: 1. Order to a Tier-2 seat that holds the invoke (the Y75 seat), cut by the issuer; the order names these writes. Use 49financial as the firm and an advisor of it, as Y75 did.

2. Copy org/tier2_senior/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~DELL2/deliverables/irpt_y75/y75_x1_arms.py and y75_x1_poll.py to a scratch folder and change two things: CSV = b'Ticker,Dollars
AAPL,10000
TOTAL,10000
TOTALS,10000
SUBTOTAL,10000
SUM,10000
ALL,10000
ZQXJV9,10000
' and a new token (RUN prefix). AAPL is the known-found control; ZQXJV9 is the made-up control that must come back not found. (The rows are 2..8; the row number in a finding is the sheet row, header = row 1.)
3. python -c: X.put_filer(); then X.invoke(X.event(advisor_email=<A>, token=<T>)) once; the first answer is RESOLVING with an upload_id.
4. python y75_x1_poll.py (re-POST the same token every 30 s, up to 15 minutes) until the state is NORMALIZED or NEEDS_CORRECTION.
5. Delete the filer row and confirm NOT FOUND with ConsistentRead (as Y75 step 8).
exact_invocation.what_in_the_output_answers_the_question: In the terminal answer (data.state and data.findings): a finding TICKER_NOT_FOUND with value=TOTAL (or TOTALS, SUBTOTAL, SUM, ALL) at its row means the live provider answered NOT FOUND for that symbol; a symbol that is in NO finding on a NEEDS_CORRECTION answer (or any symbol on a NORMALIZED answer, where the portfolio lists it as a holding) was FOUND; TICKER_DATA_NOT_ENTITLED = a real security the account may not price; TICKER_AMBIGUOUS = several matches; TICKER_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE on one of these symbols, a state still RESOLVING at 15 minutes, or a reason RESOLVE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED / RESOLVE_PROVIDER_BUSY = the provider was NOT read and there is NO answer. The read is valid only if AAPL is not in the findings and ZQXJV9 is TICKER_NOT_FOUND; otherwise record it as void. Spaced labels (Grand Total, Portfolio Total) are not asked by this sheet because they never reach the provider (see symbol_each_label_becomes).
exact_invocation.in_process_stub_answer: Under the offline stub of round 13 (classify_batch over a receipt that returns a row for every symbol-shaped word) TOTAL, TOTALS, SUBTOTAL, SUM and ALL are all FOUND and the sheet is NORMALIZED with the total counted as a holding (round 13: 600 on a 300 sheet); the recording stub of this cell answered NOT_FOUND by construction and so says nothing about the provider. Grand Total / Portfolio Total never reach the stub and are turned back as TICKER_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE. Neither says what the live provider answers.
